text_284bc2a831a1: The same map legend applies to the driver portal and administration: unknown grey, acquiring blue, qualified light green, ageing orange, expired red. DB InfaGo construction sections are grey-brown; non-DB InfaGo network is yellow. Confirmed imported qualification keeps priority over GPS. Administration selects a driver through search and a dropdown. Data is loaded from the server for that driver; local recordings and a logged-in driver’s private cache are not used. Driver selection is locked while saving. Staff need the new module permission Read or Read/Write. With write access, rolling-stock entries can be added or selected for editing. Leading zeros are preserved.
text_06452a53499d: Administration knowledge module with driver search and rolling-stock editing. Shared new map colours and legend labels in both portals.
